mainEntity.name: Copyfy or Ecomhunt: which is best?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z: AI product research, competitor store analysis, product pages and image import to Shopify. Ecomhunt is better if you just want a daily pick of trending products to test. To launch and run a store, Copyfy wins; for plain product discovery, Ecomhunt stays useful.

Yes, at entry level: Ecomhunt starts at 29€/month against 49€/month for Copyfy. But Ecomhunt is limited to a daily product selection, while Copyfy covers product research, competitor store analysis, AI listings and store generation. Add up the tools you need for the same result and the bill goes past 49€/month. The free trial runs 5 days, no credit card.

Yes. Copyfy integrates directly with Shopify and lets you automatically import competitor visuals to your store. Ecomhunt, on the other hand, goes through a Chrome extension and offers no native e-commerce integration.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate from Ecomhunt to Copyfy?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Many users switch to Copyfy for a more versatile tool: instead of being limited to product discovery, they get AI research, competitor analysis, product pages and Shopify integration in one place.

Yes, for plain trending-product discovery and its Chrome extension, Ecomhunt does the job and relies on a large community. It stays limited, though, next to an all-in-one solution like Copyfy, which covers the whole chain up to going live.
